# Baseline execution scopes

Inert authored fixture; no target execution or infrastructure verification. The command process selects alpha, beta or unrelated; two active configured callbacks permit an event cycle.

- [alpha](execution.md#flow_6daded7ae701) — CLI alpha.
- [beta](execution.md#flow_e8a0c4059ae6) — CLI beta.
- [shared](execution.md#flow_d814e61191d1) — Configured relay callback.
- [consumer](execution.md#flow_9f3625e6d230) — Configured jobs callback.
- [unrelated](execution.md#flow_010761f5e0b5) — CLI unrelated.
